meaning:
προσ-τρέχω
[in LXX for רוּץ ;]
to run to: Mrk.9:15 10:17, Act.8:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
